sql: select coalesce((select classification from crm_stages where name=leads.estado),'open') as "classification", "estado", "management_type", count(*) as "count" from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and coalesce((select classification from crm_stages where name=leads.estado),'open') = $1 group by 1, "estado", "management_type"

select * from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and coalesce((select classification from crm_stages where name=leads.estado),'open') = $1 order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $2
